What do other customers say in their reviews, does it actually hold up?
Independent and customer reviews reflect both positive feedback and areas where we’ve worked to make improvements:
What customers appreciate:
Comfort and style: Many owners highlight the balance of comfort and modern design, as well as the ease of assembly.
Modularity and longevity: Customers who have moved multiple times often mention modularity as a standout feature, because modules can easily be rearranged, expanded, or carried through tight spaces.
Component replacements: Owners value being able to clean removable covers or order individual replacement parts instead of having to buy a whole new couch.
Concerns raised in reviews & how we’ve addressed them:
Cushion settling: Some reviews—especially on our loose-cushion models like Ciello and Gaia—note that fiber-filled cushions require regular fluffing (every 1–2 weeks) to avoid flattening. Atmosphere uses layered high-density foam instead, which holds its shape much more consistently and has far fewer maintenance complaints.
Fabric pilling: Older reviews (prior to 2024) frequently mentioned fabric wear and pilling. In 2024, we discontinued those earlier fabrics and introduced stricter durability standards; complaints about premature wear have declined significantly since. Choosing durable options like Aquaforte Velvet (tested to 200,000 Martindale cycles) provides the strongest resistance to friction and wear.
Delivery & fulfillment: Some critical reviews point to delivery delays, split package deliveries, or missing parts. We’ve since introduced warehouse barcode scanning and improved fulfillment tracking to reduce these issues.
Overall, on platforms like Trustpilot, Cozey holds a rating of approximately 4.1 out of 5 based on thousands of reviews, and our frames are engineered to last 20+ years under normal residential use with proper care.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best result and longevity from your Atmosphere sofa, here are the key care and usage guidelines:
Assembly & Setup:
When assembling, make sure to use the included leg-based connectors to keep the seating modules securely attached together.
Remove any protective Velcro coverings from the underside of the units and the covers during assembly so the fabric grips properly.
Cleaning & Washing the Covers:
Machine wash in cold water using a mild, fragrance-free detergent.
Turn the covers inside out and close all zippers before placing them in the machine to protect the fabric.
Drying: You can tumble dry on a no-heat setting, hang them to air dry, or lay them flat to dry. Ensure the covers are completely dry before reinstalling them.
General Fabric Maintenance:
Address spills promptly to prevent them from setting into permanent stains.
For routine deep cleaning, washing the removable covers every 1 to 2 years is a good starting point depending on household use.
If light surface pilling occurs over time from everyday friction, gently use a fabric shaver to refresh the appearance.
If you notice a snagged thread, carefully trim the protruding thread rather than pulling it.
Cushion Care:
Because Atmosphere features layered high-density foam seating with cushions embedded into the structure, you do not need to worry about a routine fluffing schedule—it naturally retains its shape and rebounds after use.
